summary: Search upserts merge into the stored listing JSON (detail fetches still replace it), and --epc only sends energyLabel values the search API accepts (F and G have no +/- variants).
reason: A later find/watch erased fields captured by enrich (Greptile, PR #2048); --epc F,G returned HTTP 400 because F_PLUS/G_MINUS are not in the API enumeration.
validated_outcome: TestMergeListingJSONKeepsEnrichedFields, TestExpandEPCOnlyEmitsAcceptedLabels; live: find --postcode 1030 --epc F,G returns 52 listings.
